events.subtitle: Bird Lives! A Charlie Parker Birthday Celebration
events.category: Charlie Parker lineage / Two-saxophone quintet / Smoke residency
events.factual_description: Smoke Jazz Club presents Bird Lives! A Charlie Parker Birthday Celebration from Wednesday, August 26 through Sunday, August 30, 2026. The residency is led by Vincent Herring on alto saxophone and Eric Alexander on tenor saxophone, with Mike LeDonne on piano and John Webber on bass. Smoke lists 6:30 PM and 8:30 PM shows throughout the run, with additional 10:00 PM shows on Friday August 28 and Saturday August 29. The venue frames the engagement around Herring and Alexander's long-running two-saxophone collaboration, which includes The Battle: Live at Smoke and the more recent Split Decision. Smoke's currently accessible primary pages conflict on the drummer assignment, listing Lewis Nash on the residency hub and Carl Allen on current show-list/individual pages, so no drummer is asserted in the canonical candidate until the venue resolves that inconsistency.

enrichment.note: Exact Smoke residency/ticket hub, full date range, date-specific showtime pattern, four consistently verified personnel, and two exact Apple Music album pages are verified. Smoke's own current pages disagree on the drummer (Lewis Nash versus Carl Allen); the disputed drummer field is intentionally omitted rather than guessed.

The candidate therefore omits the disputed drummer rather than fabricating certainty. Exact Apple Music pages verify Split Decision and The Battle. Repository search found no existing Bird Lives / Herring-Alexander Smoke 2026 record before publication.

en.why_it_matters: This belongs on RADAR because the Charlie Parker frame lands on a collaboration with its own real history rather than a pickup tribute band. Herring and Alexander have been testing alto against tenor at Smoke for more than two decades, and their recordings from the room show how much of the music comes from friction, shared vocabulary, and instant response. Putting that relationship inside a Parker birthday week makes the lineage audible without turning it into museum repertory.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the remaining sets if New York is already in play, especially if saxophone identity and hard-bop lineage are part of the trip. Five nights provide enough flexibility that I would not displace a genuinely singular premiere, farewell, or one-off to make it happen.

es.why_it_matters: Ésta merece RADAR porque el marco de Charlie Parker cae sobre una colaboración con historia propia, no sobre una banda armada para hacer un tributo. Herring y Alexander llevan más de dos décadas poniendo alto y tenor frente a frente en Smoke, y sus grabaciones de esa misma sala dejan claro que buena parte de la música nace de la fricción, el vocabulario compartido y la reacción instantánea. Meter esa relación dentro de una semana dedicada a Parker vuelve audible el linaje sin convertirlo en repertorio de museo.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los sets si Nueva York ya está en juego, sobre todo si el viaje viene siguiendo identidad de saxofón y linaje hard-bop. Cinco noches dan suficiente flexibilidad para no desplazar por esto un estreno, despedida o one-off verdaderamente singular.
